question: What exalted identity is claimed for one who is truly divine?
premises: The subject is one who is divine.
That one is emphatically identified as Viṣṇu.
The text denies any doubt about this claim.
inference: Therefore the truly divine one is declared to be Viṣṇu without doubt.
plain_english: Whoever is truly divine is indeed Viṣṇu; there is no doubt here.
